description: This file defines a command handler class for proposing and accepting client transfer requests in the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and acts as a Spring service to process specific transfer commands.

classes.name: ProposeAndAcceptClientTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class implementing the command handler for proposing and accepting client transfers, utilizing TransferWritePlatformService.

methods.name: ProposeAndAcceptClientTransferCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a TransferWritePlatformService instance.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to propose and accept a client transfer by delegating to the write platform service.
